 - [ ] `UNKNOWN_37` (`VIS` `SpecialLumpClass`?)

 - [ ] `UNKNOWN_57`
 - [ ] ~~`UNKNOWN_97`~~ `LIGHTMAP_DATA_UNKNOWN`
 
 ## Theories / Summaries
### `37..39`
Could be CSM & VIS related
Going by other lumps loaded around them in season3's `.exe`

### `43`
`CUBEMAPS_AMBIENT_RCP`
A memory page for holding a `txtx` `.rpak` asset

### `44..48`
WaterBodies system
Introduced in Season 11 w/ Storm Point for the ocean shader
 * #166

### `57`
Introduced in Season 21 (first appearance of `rBSP v52.1`)
Cannot find `.bsp_lump` in `.rpak`

### `97`
Could be lightmap related
 * #122

Season 11 is also when the move to v`49.1` / v`50.1` happened (`.bsp_lump` only lumps)
There were some v`49` depot maps, which is odd because Season 10 has just introduced `v50`
Also, some Season 11 folders don't use `UNKNOWN_48`

Though IIRC Storm Point had been in development the longest of the 4 BR mode maps

Now that we know `44..48` is the `WaterBodies` system
I wonder if the season12 & 13 `canyonlands_staging` used `WaterBodies`

We should establish a timeline of when each lump was introduced
A job for the Apex Archive!

According to `git blame` we've been tracking `UNKNOWN_97` since the 30th of June 2021


My Apex Legends archives are a little patchy in places, **so nailing down format changes could get tricky**
I have almost nothing before Season 5, besides the R5R S3 builds

For some seasons I only grabbed the maps with `.vpk`s that were touched that patch
Can probably refer to [SteamDB](https://steamdb.info) to check exactly when each map is updated
> NOTE: `.vpk` can be updated without touching maps
Digging further in #122, I found that `UNKNOWN_97` probably predates the Steam release of Apex

`002B` `CUBEMAPS_AMBIENT_RCP` is variable size
Always null bytes

I joked that it might be like `LIGHTMAP_DATA_RTL_PAGE` & turns out that's accurate
The lumps sizes matches the `txtx` `.rpak` assets for the map
`texture_extension/%s%s/cubemaps_hdr/cubemap_ambients.rpak`

So, for now we're going to say `RCP` stands for **R**pak **C**ursed **P**age

Mostly have the `WaterBodies` system cracked now:
 * #166
